variants.asks: the pull does work on what falls. How fast is a body falling in from far going at a place - and is that what puts the two into the metric?

parts.is: what bodies' rays grow where they meet
parts.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. ANNIHILATION read on two bodies' rays: each still leaves the point behind it where the way behind is dark, and behind a body's ray - lit by a source, not by CREATE, and met in the vacuum's dark half - nothing stands, so both gates are open

standing_for.name: \Phi
standing_for.because: THE POTENTIAL. The flux is fixed and the sites it is shared between go as the shell, so what one site is open to falls as `r^{-\paren{D - 1}}` and its integral - which is what a potential IS - falls one power weaker. Nobody types the exponent: it is the shell's, less one, and at three dimensions it is the `1/r` general relativity has

standing_for.name: \bar{m}
standing_for.because: the mass is what a body announces per unit of the face it announces through, at the size where its own depth has stopped mattering - which is a limit, and is written as one

standing_for.name: \bar{r}
standing_for.because: the separation is what the pair has and neither body does - and it is not `R`, which in `massOf` is a body's own thickness. Two lengths that never met until a law was written with a mass in it

standing_for.name: T_{vac}
standing_for.because: the vacuum's channel with its two bodies and the shell divided out - a SCREENED transport, which is what is left of a shortfall that spread and was damped. The damping is a power and not an exponential because a carrier takes whole steps and on each one is either destroyed or not, and `L` is where damping balances dilution

standing_for.name: \mathcal{D}
standing_for.because: ONE MOTION, TWO EFFECTS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS HERE. `EMISSION` is gated on `spare = not(moving)`, so a tick spent crossing a cell is a tick not spent shining and a body emits on 1 - \beta of its ticks - THE SAME IN EVERY DIRECTION, so that is how much the body sends and it is already in the mass, inside the source's own choice, `l.choose\paren{\bar{m}_{x·l.DEG·\paren{1 - \beta}}}`. WHAT IS DIRECTIONAL IS THE OTHER HALF: `MOVEMENT` gives one cell a tick, so a distance IS a time, and between two emissions a tick apart the body has closed \beta\cdot\hat{d} of the way to wherever the ray is going - they land that much closer together and what arrives per tick is the reciprocal. IT IS THE CLASSICAL DOPPLER FACTOR and nothing about waves or observers went into it. A body blocks the vacuum's making whether it moves or not, so this is on the meeting term and nowhere else

standing_for.name: T_{met}
standing_for.because: the meetings' channel the same way - the interference term of the two bodies' own radiation, which is why it needs BOTH to be shining where the vacuum's needs only one to be open. It carries a different power of the separation, and the crossover between the two is what turns a rotation curve over

standing_for.name: a_{0}
standing_for.because: THE SCALE IS THE EMPTY VACUUM'S OWN GROWTH, v H_{\Lambda}, and it is the same at every place and every epoch. Read at the place, as the growth the matter there makes, it would change gravity where it is best measured (a planet's orbit) by far more than it allows unless the world's matter is too thin to lift anything; read as the age, or as the whole world's growth rate, a_{0} was three to four times larger at z = 2 and Genzel's six discs would carry dark fractions of 0.3 where they carry at most 0.2 - so neither. What does not change with the matter or the age is the vacuum's own growth, the rate at which its beat, left to itself, grows points: that is H_{\Lambda}, and a_{0} = v H_{\Lambda}. Measured, a_{0}/cH_{0} = v \sqrt{\Omega_{\Lambda}}, a coincidence of this epoch. It was read before as: WHAT ENDS THE ACCUMULATION IS THE BEGINNING, not a meeting. A meeting ends a CARRIER, and the mean free path is how far one gets - but nothing of a body's rays is ended by the vacuum it rides through: what is sent at a distance is what was sent, spread, and the medium carries it as far as there is medium (`Medium` streams a body's rays with no absorption at all, and the pull it gives falls as the shell does and no faster). The phase, though, is counted in TICKS against the vacuum's own beat, and there have only ever been so many of them: the frontier grows one cell a tick, so the age is t_{0} = 1/H and the longest a mismatch can have been piling up is that. So the scale is v over the age, which is vH - and a_{0}/cH comes out as v itself, a count of the tiling and nothing else

standing_for.name: \omega
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. `outward` finds the point across the way, and where that point has been folded it follows it through to the hub it was folded into - so a way that led somewhere still does, hub or point. It comes back with nothing only where there is no point across the way at all, which is the edge of a finite world. The vacuum the line is written in is infinite: every way has a point across it, and the share of ways with room ahead is all of them

standing_for.name: n_{f}
standing_for.because: a meeting leaves a fold and a creation over a held point takes one off, so what a place has swallowed is not a tally that only grows - it settles where its own line nets nought. THE LINE NETTING NEGATIVE DOES NOT MEAN THE LEVEL IS NOUGHT: the vacuum is working the whole time, and what stands is the rate folds are written over the rate one is cleared. The line is linear in the record, so that is a quotient and not a search - and at the settled density, where the making pays for the taking, it comes to DEG/2: one fold for every two ways, the record the vacuum keeps of its own. A BODY ADDS TO IT: what it prevents spreads, and an accumulation of what arrives is one power weaker than the flux. `turns` draws on the sum, so both belong

standing_for.name: \sigma
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. a rewrite fires on every match it has, once a tick - that is what a rule of this model is. So its rate is ONE per match per tick, and the name on it says which rewrite rather than how often: there is nothing here to choose or to fit

standing_for.name: F
standing_for.because: the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving

standing_for.name: \bar{c}
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - the term + \sigma \paren{1 - \omega}n of the continuous model: 0 rays a firing, at rate \sigma, on the share 1 - \omega of the matches, of degree 1 in the density; what this fact takes from it is below. every active ray goes ONE CELL along its own exit in one tick, which is what the streaming term says - so a step is one cell, and that is the only length the lattice has to measure anything else against

standing_for.name: \rho
standing_for.because: and the density the line's own terms carry IS that settled one, everywhere the line is about the vacuum rather than about a source - so a law written in terms of the density can be written in terms of the rates instead

standing_for.name: \nu

standing_for.name: \delta n_{f}
standing_for.because: what a body ADDS to the fold record, over what the vacuum settles to on its own. The settled part is everywhere alike and is the vacuum's own index; this is the part that depends on where you are relative to a body, and it is what a metric is

standing_for.name: l.\bar{m}
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. the line is written at a local, l, and what a source puts in there is its mass - a choice over that local's ways out: which of its l.DEG exits it lights, at \bar{m}_{x} apiece, on the ticks its own rule leaves it. The gate the rule asked of the source is inside the choice because it is a statement about which exits, and the line carries nothing of the source but this

standing_for.name: l.reach\paren{\bar{R}}
standing_for.because: a ray on a heading is taken at one over the free path per step, so the share of what set out that is still on that heading R steps later is one less that, to the R. It is a count of the rays themselves and nothing else: a meeting that takes a ray writes a fold, and the fold is carried by the record and read back out by creation - so this is the NEAR field, the direct arrival, and it is what a body's own cells shadow one another by. Beyond a free path the body is still there, as record

Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

steps.via: a body falling in from far
steps.because: a body let go at rest far off gains speed as the pull does work on it: \frac{d}{dt}\frac{\beta^{2}}{2} = g·\beta, and the pull is the potential's slope - so at R its speed squared is twice the potential there. Every body falls so, whatever it is made of: the pull is the record's slope, and the record does not ask what crosses it

derivation.because: the pull integrated in from far off, where it is nought: one power of the distance weaker than the pull. It is the record the body left, in rays' worth and halved - so the potential is not a second field beside the record, it IS the record

derivation.via: the pull far from a body
working: n_{f,l} - n_{f}\paren{\rho_{\infty}} \to \frac{x.\bar{m}·D·\sigma·F·\rho_{\infty}·x.\bar{R}^{2 - D}}{2·\paren{D - 2}}, past the free path
derivation.because: what a body feels is the record's slope in rays' worth, g = \frac{1}{2}\nabla S_{l}, and S_{l} = 2n_{f,l}. Far from a body - past its free path, where the reach has died - the record it leaves is what the walk carries, one power of the distance weaker than the shell, so its slope falls as the shell does: the inverse square at three dimensions, at a strength that is the lattice's own and nothing chosen. G is the dimension over twice the free path

derivation.via: the record every body leaves at a local
working: the settled vacuum underneath: n_{f} at \rho_{\infty}, \frac{DEG_{0}·\rho_{\infty}^{2}}{4·\paren{1 - \rho_{\infty}}}
x = x_{@t}: every body at its own time, bound once in the sum; x.\bar{R} = l.distance\paren{x.l}, from the local now to the body then
the walk: CREATION lights all DEG of a point's ways, so a heading is drawn afresh; \lambda = \frac{1}{\sigma·F·\rho_{\infty}}, outward at \bar{c}·\paren{D - 2}\lambda / \paren{D·x.\bar{R}}
derivation.because: a meeting turns 2 of l's rays into a fold and a creation reads it back out, so l's rays, DEG of them a way, and 2 times its record move together: the meetings cancel out of their sum, and what is left is what the bodies put in and creation's share against the record l holds over its own ways - nought where the ways have settled, at \rho_{\infty}. So what a body puts in is never lost to the vacuum, only spread: what crosses the shell at a distance in a tick is what the body put out then, and the rays alone are the near field, what still arrives as rays, spread over the same shell - the record is the one less the other, so it is what the meetings took on the way, never less than nought. And what they took walks rather than streams - a creation reads it back out on every way at once - so it crosses each shell at c-bar (D - 2) lambda / (D R), lambda the free path, and beyond the free path stands 1/R^{D-2} deep: in three dimensions it falls as one over the distance, and its slope, the pull, as one over its square, over 2, on the settled record. Each body is read as it was when its rays left it, at its own distance then
